pooling: semantic block post-update residual, spatial256 tokens only; patch RMS eps1e-6 then GAP
optimizer: fresh zero heads AdamW cosine .01 -> .0001 epoch/39; wd0, default betas
precision: BF16 autocast frozen semantic backbone; FP32 probes
data: ImageNet1281167 train, 50000 val; existing uint8 center-crop cache, no flip
noise: input z=(1-alpha)x+alpha epsilon; pixel x in [-1,1], t=1-alpha
rng: Group1 distributed protocol: seed700001+epoch+rank*10000000; same within these four 2-GPU runs, not bitwise identical to different world sizes
validation: 3 matched-noise full50k views, seed800001..800003 + rank*10000000; separate auxiliary clean view
